strings.greeting: Su'aal ka weydii casharkan. Jawaabtu waxay ka imanaysaa qoraalka casharka.
strings.cloudConsent: Ikhtiyaar: haddii la calaamadiyo, su'aashaada iyo qaybta casharka ee la helay waxaa loo diri karaa AI-ga daruuraha ee goobtan loo habeeyey. Haddii aan la calaamadin, raadinta casharka ayaa la adeegsanayaa.

strings.escalationSent: Codsigaaga safka ayaa la geliyey. Macallimiintu way maqnaan karaan, xataa 23:00. Waqtiga jawaabtu wuu kala duwan yahay, mana jiro dammaanad. Halkan ku soo noqo oo dooro Hubi jawaabta macallinka.
strings.tutorAvailability: Macallimiintu way maqnaan karaan, xataa 23:00. Codsiyada safka ayaa la geliyaa, laakiin waqtiga jawaabtu wuu kala duwan yahay, mana jiro dammaanad. Halkan ku soo noqo oo dooro Hubi jawaabta macallinka.
strings.tutorReplyPending: Weli jawaab ma jirto. Codsigaagu weli wuu sugayaa. Mar dambe dib u hubi.
strings.tutorUpdateAvailable: Macallin ayaa cusboonaysiin soo diray. Codsigaagu weli wuu furan yahay; mar dambe hubi jawaabta kama dambaysta ah.
strings.tutorReplyAvailable: Macallin ayaa jawaabay. Jawaabta waxaa lagu muujiyey wada sheekaysigan.

strings.ticketDataDeleteConfirm: Ma rabtaa inaad si joogto ah u tirtirto codsigan macallinka iyo lifaaqyadiisa?

strings.clearLocalDataConfirm: Ma nadiifinaysaa taariikhda wada sheekaysiga, su'aalaha safka ku jira, xogta casharka ee kaydsan iyo furayaasha codsiga biraawsarkan? Tani ma tirtirayso codsiyada server-ka.

strings.screenShareConsent: Waxaan oggolahay inaan macallin la wadaago shaashaddayda ama faahfaahinta bogga. Wadaagistu waxay bilaabmaysaa oo keliya marka aan badhanka riixo. Fiidiyow toos ah lama duubo ama lama kaydiyo; URL-ka bogga, magaca iyo HTML-ka qaybta la doortay, cinwaannada bogga, iyo sawir-shaashadeed kasta oo aan doorto waxaa lagu daraa codsiga macallinka.
strings.screenShareNote: HTTPS ayaa loo baahan yahay si shaashad loo wadaago. Kombiyuutarku wuxuu adeegsadaa WebRTC toos ah oo demo ah; STUN/TURN relay lama habayn, sidaas darteed shabakadaha qaarkood way xannibi karaan. Android Chrome wuxuu diraa faahfaahinta bogga iyo sawir ikhtiyaari ah oo keliya, ma aha fiidiyow toos ah.
strings.screenShareConnecting: Macallinka ayaa la sugayaa inuu ku xirmo (gaadiid demo ah).
strings.screenShareConnected: Waxaad ku xiran tahay macallinka. Fiidiyow toos ah lama duubo.

strings.voiceCommandListening: Waxaan dhageysanayaa hawshaada. Weydii cashar ama shaqo, codso macallin, ama dheh “dir” marka aad dib u eegto codsiga macallinka.
strings.voiceCommandQueued: Telefoonkan ayaa lagu kaydiyey. Waa la farsamayn doonaa marka internet jiro. Diristu waxay u baahan tahay codsi ansax ah iyo xaqiijin cad.
strings.voiceCommandConsent: Si aad wada sheekaysiga u wadaagto, fur La hadal qof, calaamadee oggolaanshaha, dabadeed codsiga macallinka ku celi.
strings.voiceCommandFailed: Codsiga codka lama farsamayn karin. Halkii ku qor.
strings.voiceCommandUnavailable: Aqoonsiga hadalka ee aan internetka u baahnayn kama jiro seerfarkan. Codsiga waad qori kartaa.
